name: ATM Cassette Counters 6
definition: ATM cassette counter per unit value or globally.

UnitValue.name: Unit Value
UnitValue.definition: Amount of one media unit, if the media type is valued.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of the media, if the media type is valued and different from the currency of the requested amount.

InitialCount.name: Initial Count
InitialCount.definition: Number of media items in cassette after last replenishment.

CurrentNumber.name: Current Number
CurrentNumber.definition: Current number of media present in the cassette.

FlowTotals.name: Flow Totals
FlowTotals.definition: Counters of media inside the cassette.
